name: Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences Ltd
title: Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences Ltd - 543308 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin fell to 19.9% (from 25.3% a year ago) as new beds ramp; mature units hold ~28.5-30% margin, new units eroded ~INR 32 crore in Q4 and ~INR 128 crore for FY26.

capex.quote: INR 50 crores to INR 75 crores over, we don't need it for the FY '27. We may need it in FY '28 or FY '29

triggers.label: Kondapur capex ~INR 50-75 cr deferred to FY28+
triggers.quote: we don't need it for the FY '27. We may need it in FY '28 or FY '29

triggers.label: Net debt to fall ~INR 1,000 cr via QIP
triggers.quote: I think may be to the tune of INR 1,000 crores is what we should retire debt.

triggers.label: Telangana EBITDA growth guided 10-12%
triggers.quote: maybe around 10%-12% EBITDA growth we should look at for Telangana cluster.

triggers.label: Bangalore ARPOB base 75,000 assumed
triggers.quote: for modeling purpose, we should just assume 75,000 annually.

triggers.label: Insurance empanelment delays hit new hospitals
triggers.quote: the only difficulty off late is the insurance empowerment.

guidance.quote: maybe around 10%-12% EBITDA growth we should look at for Telangana cluster.
may be to the tune of INR 1,000 crores is what we should retire debt.
clear visibility of how it will go to INR 25-30 crores over the next 12 months.

prior_guidance_check.quote: the idea is now that the debt has reached its peak, close to INR 3,000 plus crores

red_flags.label: Q4 PAT down ~69% YoY, EPS down 37% for FY26
red_flags.quote: PAT at INR 33 crores in Quarter 4 Financial Year '26 against INR 106 crore

red_flags.label: Insurance empanelment delays on new hospitals
red_flags.quote: we are yet to get the empanelment, but at least the negotiations are more or less through.

red_flags.label: Net debt ~INR 3,000 cr after guiding debt peak; QIP of INR 1,500 cr
red_flags.quote: we announced the QIP. Can you help us understand the reasons behind the planned INR 1,500 crore QIP?

evasions.topic: Forward growth numbers (top line / bottom line target)
evasions.quote: Forward-looking numbers, we are not able to share, but I think it should be similar to how we have been able to grow in the past.
I don't think it is appropriate to comment on that now.
It is difficult to look at it at a company level because there is a lot of new hospitals getting commissioned
